assumptions.statement_zh: 官方精确SITE与KEY_AREA多边形尚未取得，当前采用仓库临时粗略边界。
assumptions.statement_en: Official exact SITE and KEY_AREA polygons are unavailable; repository provisional rough geometry is used.

assumptions.statement_zh: 现状建筑、道路、设施和使用行为未完成授权现场核验。
assumptions.statement_en: Existing buildings, roads, facilities and use patterns have not been verified through authorised fieldwork.

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、高度、退线等法定控制条件缺失。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls such as FAR, height and setbacks are unavailable.

assumptions.statement_zh: 建筑图层为概念体量，不代表现状、权属或拆改留决定。
assumptions.statement_en: The building layer is concept massing, not an existing-condition, ownership or retain-renovate-demolish decision.

assumptions.statement_zh: 四季生态、土壤、树根、暗夜、噪声与微气候基线待专业调查。
assumptions.statement_en: Seasonal ecology, soil, roots, darkness, noise and microclimate baselines require professional survey.

assumptions.statement_zh: 道路与慢行网络是概念连接，不是官方路线或交通实测。
assumptions.statement_en: Road and slow-mobility networks are conceptual links, not official alignments or measured traffic.

assumptions.statement_zh: 所有责任主体和运营者均未确认。
assumptions.statement_en: All accountable entities and operators remain unconfirmed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 无可靠工程量、报价、资金承诺或采购依据。
assumptions.statement_en: No reliable quantities, quotations, funding commitments or procurement basis exists.

assumptions.statement_zh: 所有场景为概念合同，未授权、未实施、未开展真实用户测试。
assumptions.statement_en: All scenarios are concept contracts: unauthorised, unimplemented and without real-user testing.

assumptions.statement_zh: 国际案例只比较机制，不平移规模、绩效、政策或资金。
assumptions.statement_en: International cases compare mechanisms only; scale, performance, policy and finance are not transferred.

assumptions.statement_zh: 城市智能双门制是方案自设、可撤回的城市设计与治理规则，不是现行普遍法定义务或法定许可。
assumptions.statement_en: The Civic AI Dual-Gate Protocol is a participant-authored, reversible design and governance rule, not a universal current legal obligation or statutory permit.

assumptions.statement_zh: 生命影响指标是待测量框架，不是已观测生态绩效。
assumptions.statement_en: Life-impact metrics are a measurement framework, not observed ecological performance.
